name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Whisk buttermilk, egg, melted butter and vanilla in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients without overmixing.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Cook until bubbles appear, flip and cook until golden.

name: Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the eggs.
Spread mashed avocado over the toast.
Place one egg on each slice.
Finish with chili flakes and serve.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Add a layer of yogurt into two glasses.
Sprinkle with granola and chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey and serve chilled.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, milk and vanilla.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes and flip.
Cook the other side until golden.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Fold the omelette and cook until set.

name: Classic French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and sugar.
Dip each bread slice into the mixture.
Melt butter in a frying pan.
Cook bread for 2 to 3 minutes on each side.

name: Blueberry Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey and cinnamon.
Stir the mixture in the morning.

name: Cheese and Herb Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat.
Stir slowly until soft curds form.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with chives.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie Bowl
steps: Place banana, strawberries, yogurt and milk in a blender.

name: Moroccan Msemen with Honey
steps: Mix flour, semolina, salt and sugar.
Gradually add warm water and knead until smooth.
Divide into small balls and coat with oil.
Brush with butter and oil, then fold into a square.
Cook on a pan until golden on both sides.

name: Breakfast Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Cook the eggs in olive oil until scrambled.
Place one tortilla in a clean pan.
Add half the cheese, scrambled eggs, tomato and spring onions.
Add the remaining cheese and cover with the second tortilla.
Cook on both sides until golden and the cheese melts.

name: Apple Cinnamon Porridge
steps: Add oats, milk and salt to a saucepan.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes while stirring.
Top with maple syrup and walnuts.

name: Mushroom Cheese Toast
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Add mushrooms and cook until browned.

name: Breakfast Egg Muffins
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Divide vegetables and cheese between muffin cups.
Pour egg mixture into each cup.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until set.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Spread peanut butter over each slice.
Sprinkle with chia seeds and cinnamon.

name: Cottage Cheese Fruit Bowl
steps: Place cottage cheese in a serving bowl.
Arrange pineapple, strawberries and blueberries on top.

name: Belgian Style Waffles
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk eggs, milk, butter and vanilla separately.
Pour batter into the waffle iron.
Serve with fruit or maple syrup.

name: Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Bagel
steps: Cut the bagels in half and toast lightly.
Spread cream cheese over each half.
Arrange cucumber and red onion slices.
Garnish with fresh dill and serve.

name: Shakshuka Breakfast Eggs
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet.
Add onion and bell pepper and cook until softened.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until thickened.
Make four wells in the sauce and add the eggs.
Cover and cook until egg whites are set.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Cinnamon French Crepes
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, butter, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat a lightly buttered non-stick pan.
Pour a small amount of batter and swirl to cover the pan.
Flip and cook the other side briefly.
Repeat with remaining batter and serve.

name: Spinach Feta Breakfast Wrap
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil and cook spinach until wilted.
Divide the egg mixture between the tortillas.
Toast briefly in a dry pan and serve.

name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
steps: Heat olive oil in a tagine.
Cover and cook until chicken is tender.

name: Moroccan Couscous with Vegetables
steps: Prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
Cook onion and tomatoes with spices.

name: Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Season chicken with paprika, salt and pepper.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Add mushrooms and cook until soft.

name: Tuna and Avocado Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Add lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Beef Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Stir fry until vegetables are tender.

name: Baked Salmon with Potatoes
steps: Season potatoes with oil and rosemary.
Bake until salmon is cooked through.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Add cooked rice and soy sauce.

name: Moroccan Kefta Tagine
steps: Mix minced beef with spices and parsley.
Crack eggs on top and cook until set.

name: Greek Chicken Pita
steps: Season chicken with oregano and lemon.
Fill with chicken, vegetables and yogurt sauce.

name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
steps: Cook onion and garlic in a pot.
Simmer until soft and blend if desired.

name: Shrimp Garlic Spaghetti
steps: Add shrimp and cook until pink.

name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
steps: Cook chicken in a pan until fully cooked.
Fill flatbreads with chicken and vegetables.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Dress with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

name: Moroccan Fish Chermoula
steps: Mix with lemon juice and spices.
Marinate for 20 minutes in the refrigerator.
Bake or grill until fish is fully cooked.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Mix rice with vegetables and seasoning.
Cut the tops off peppers and remove seeds.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook chicken in olive oil until done.

name: Falafel Chickpea Bowl
steps: Blend chickpeas with herbs, garlic and cumin.
Prepare a salad with lettuce and tomato.
Serve falafel with salad and tahini sauce.

name: Beef Burger with Salad
steps: Assemble burgers with cheese and serve.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Lasagna
steps: Cook spinach and drain excess water.
Spread tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Layer lasagna sheets with spinach mixture.
Add mozzarella and sauce between layers.

name: Moroccan Vegetable Briouats
steps: Mix with peas, parsley and seasoning.

name: Asian Chicken Noodle Bowl
steps: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Cook chicken with garlic and ginger.

name: Baked Potato with Tuna
steps: Mix tuna with yogurt, sweetcorn and lemon juice.
Fill with tuna mixture and garnish with parsley.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Rice
steps: Cook chicken with garlic and oil.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon and oregano.
Pour dressing over salad and serve.

name: Grilled Vegetable and Halloumi Wrap
steps: Drizzle with lemon juice and wrap.

name: Moroccan Chicken with Preserved Lemon
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Add a little water and simmer.

name: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Chicken
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Cook chicken until golden and fully cooked.

name: Baked Salmon with Lemon
steps: Place salmon in a baking dish.
Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and oregano.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked through.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Cook vegetables in olive oil until tender.
Spread tomato sauce in a baking dish.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey and cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Stir fry until broccoli is tender-crisp and beef is cooked.

name: Moroccan Kefta with Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix ground beef with cumin, paprika, cilantro and salt.
Heat olive oil and cook onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook until meatballs are fully cooked.

name: Creamy Spinach Pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice
steps: Cut the tops off the peppers and remove seeds.
Cook onion and ground beef in olive oil.
Mix with cooked rice and some tomato sauce.
Stuff the peppers with the mixture.
Pour remaining tomato sauce around them.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until tender.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Mix chicken with paprika, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Serve chicken and vegetables inside tortillas.

name: Lentil and Vegetable Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.

name: Grilled Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Season vegetables with olive oil and spices.
Season chicken with oregano, garlic, salt and pepper.
Place chicken and vegetables on a baking tray.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Creamy Shrimp Garlic Pasta
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Cook shrimp until pink and opaque.

name: Moroccan Vegetable Couscous
steps: Prepare couscous according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large pot.
Cook onion and tomato with spices.
Serve vegetables and broth over couscous.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
steps: Beat the egg in a bowl.
Coat chicken in egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Place chicken in a baking dish.
Add tomato sauce and mozzarella on top.
Bake another 10 minutes until chicken is fully cooked and cheese melts.

name: Asian Sesame Chicken Bowl
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and minced garlic.
Cook chicken in a pan until fully cooked.
Pour the sauce over chicken and simmer briefly.
Add chicken and vegetables over rice.

name: Baked Eggplant with Tomato and Cheese
steps: Slice eggplants and brush with olive oil.
Layer eggplant and tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes until cheese is melted.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Rice
steps: Mix ground turkey with egg, breadcrumbs, chopped onion and seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Cover and simmer until meatballs are fully cooked.

name: Tuna Potato Bake
steps: Mix tuna with chopped onion and cream.
Layer potatoes and tuna mixture in a baking dish.

name: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.

name: Grilled Beef Kofta with Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, parsley and spices.
Shape mixture into long kofta pieces.
Grill or pan-cook until fully cooked.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic and lemon juice.
Serve kofta with yogurt sauce and salad.

name: Moroccan Harira Soup
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and cook until tender.
Chop onion, tomatoes, celery and herbs.
Add ingredients to a large pot with lentils and spices.
Add water and simmer until lentils are tender.
Add tomato paste and cooked chickpeas.
Simmer until the soup reaches the desired consistency.

name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and herbs.
Place chicken and potatoes in a baking dish.
Roast for 35 to 45 minutes until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Vegetarian Mexican Rice Bowl
steps: Rinse and heat black beans with cumin.
Arrange rice, beans and corn in bowls.
Squeeze lime juice over the bowls.

name: Baked White Fish with Vegetables
steps: Slice the vegetables and place them in a baking dish.
Mix olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin and salt.
Coat the fish with the spice mixture.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until fish flakes easily.

name: Quick Chicken Vegetable Noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or pan.
Stir fry until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add soy sauce and cooked noodles.

name: Classic Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder.
Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla.
Pour into a greased cake pan.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake
steps: Beat cream cheese with sugar and vanilla.
Whip the cream and fold it into the mixture.

name: Moroccan Orange Cinnamon Cake
steps: Mix in flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Pour into a greased cake pan.

name: Classic Tiramisu
steps: Mix mascarpone with sugar and vanilla.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in cooled coffee.
Arrange a layer in a dish.
Spread half the cream mixture over them.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours and dust with cocoa.

name: Apple Cinnamon Crumble
steps: Mix apples with cinnamon and lemon juice.
Place apples in a baking dish.
Rub butter into flour and sugar.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.

name: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Fold in flour and cocoa powder.
Pour into a lined baking pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes and cool before cutting.

name: Vanilla Panna Cotta
steps: Heat cream, milk, sugar and vanilla gently.
Stir in the gelatin until dissolved.

name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
steps: Add eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour and baking powder.
Mix lemon juice with powdered sugar.
Pour drizzle over the warm cake.

name: Banana Bread
steps: Mix bananas with eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda and cinnamon.

name: Coconut Rice Pudding
steps: Combine rice, coconut milk, milk and salt in a saucepan.
Cook over low heat for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring regularly.
Cook until creamy and rice is tender.

name: French Chocolate Mousse
steps: Fold egg whites gently into chocolate mixture.
Whip cream and fold it in.

name: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese
steps: Fold in flour, cinnamon and baking powder.
Pour into a greased cake pan.
Beat cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar.
Cool cake completely and spread frosting on top.

name: Moroccan Almond Briouats
steps: Mix ground almonds with sugar, cinnamon and orange blossom water.
Place a small amount of filling at one end.
Dip briouats in honey and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix flour, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk eggs, milk, butter and vanilla.

name: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Add a layer of yogurt to serving glasses.

name: Classic Crème Brûlée
steps: Slowly pour warm cream into yolks while whisking.
Place ramekins in a hot water bath.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until just set.
Chill, sprinkle sugar on top and caramelize before serving.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Shape dough into small balls on a baking tray.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes and cool.

name: Mango Coconut Pudding
steps: Heat coconut milk with sugar gently.
Mix mango puree with coconut mixture.

name: Cinnamon Sugar Donuts
steps: Mix warm milk, yeast and a little sugar.
Add flour, remaining sugar, egg, butter and salt.
Cover and let rise until doubled.
Roll out and cut donut shapes.
Fry carefully in hot oil until golden.
Coat with cinnamon sugar while warm.

name: Lemon Cheesecake Cups
steps: Divide biscuit mixture into serving glasses.
Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar.
Add lemon juice, zest and vanilla.
Whip cream and fold into the cheese mixture.

name: Grilled Chicken Quinoa Bowl
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook according to package instructions.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.

name: Healthy Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with chili flakes and serve.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine vegetables and chickpeas in a bowl.
Mix lemon juice, olive oil and oregano.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.

name: Baked Salmon with Broccoli
steps: Place salmon and broccoli in a baking dish.
Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and herbs.
Pour mixture over salmon and broccoli.
Bake for 12 to 18 minutes until salmon is cooked and broccoli is tender.

name: Green Spinach Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.

name: Lentil and Carrot Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add carrots, lentils, cumin and broth.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Mix yogurt, mustard and lemon juice for dressing.

name: Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Cut peppers in half and remove seeds.
Mix quinoa, beans, tomato, onion and corn.
Season with paprika, olive oil and salt.
Fill pepper halves with the mixture.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until peppers are tender.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
steps: Place Greek yogurt in a bowl.

name: Baked Sweet Potato with Chickpeas
steps: Wash and pierce sweet potatoes with a fork.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes until soft.
Season chickpeas with paprika, cumin and olive oil.
Fill with chickpeas, add yogurt sauce and parsley.

name: Tuna and White Bean Salad
steps: Mix lemon juice, olive oil and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.

name: Oven Roasted Vegetable Bowl
steps: Toss vegetables with olive oil and spices.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes until tender.
Prepare quinoa according to package instructions.

name: Healthy Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Spoon chicken mixture into lettuce leaves.

name: Oatmeal Banana Pancakes
steps: Blend banana, eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and milk.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour small portions of batter into the pan.
Flip and cook the other side.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod
steps: Place sliced tomatoes and zucchini in a baking dish.
Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and oregano.
Pour mixture over fish and vegetables.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until fish flakes easily.

name: Avocado Chickpea Toast
steps: Lightly mash chickpeas with olive oil and paprika.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Broccoli and Quinoa Salad
steps: Allow quinoa and broccoli to cool slightly.
Dress with lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Turkey and Avocado Salad
steps: Arrange salad leaves in a bowl.
Add turkey, avocado, cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix lemon juice, olive oil and black pepper.
Drizzle dressing over salad and serve.

name: Red Lentil Sweet Potato Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add sweet potato, lentils, curry powder and broth.
Cook until lentils and sweet potato are tender.

name: Fresh Mediterranean Tomato Salad
steps: Wash and slice tomatoes and cucumber.
Arrange vegetables in a serving bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.

name: Creamy Vegan Coconut Chickpea Curry
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Season with salt and garnish with coriander.

name: Vegan Lentil Bolognese
steps: Rinse lentils and cook until tender.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Add tomato sauce, lentils and oregano.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
steps: Season with olive oil, paprika and cumin.
Warm black beans in a small pan.
Fill tortillas with sweet potatoes and beans.
Top with avocado, lime juice and coriander.

name: Fresh Vegan Mediterranean Couscous
steps: Prepare couscous according to package instructions.
Dice cucumber, tomatoes and bell pepper.
Add lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Vegan Mushroom and Spinach Risotto
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Gradually add warm vegetable broth while stirring.
Cook until rice is creamy and tender.

name: Vegan Chickpea and Avocado Sandwich
steps: Drain and mash chickpeas in a bowl.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and tahini.

name: Vegan Thai Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package instructions.
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and a little water.
Chop carrot and bell pepper into thin strips.
Cook garlic and vegetables in a pan.
Toss well and garnish with coriander.

name: Vegan Moroccan Vegetable Tagine
steps: Heat olive oil in a tagine or pot.
Add zucchini and cook until all vegetables are tender.

name: Vegan Banana Oat Cookies
steps: Add oats, peanut butter and cinnamon.
Place on a lined baking tray.

name: Vegan Quinoa Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Cut zucchinis lengthwise and scoop out the center.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Chop onion, garlic, tomato and zucchini flesh.
Fill zucchini halves with the mixture.

name: Vegan Creamy Pumpkin Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot.
Cook onion and garlic until soft.
Simmer for 20 minutes until pumpkin is tender.

name: Vegan Falafel Bowl
steps: Mash chickpeas with onion and garlic.
Mix and shape into small balls.
Bake at 200°C for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Add falafel and drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Vegan Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Cut peppers in half and remove seeds.
Cook onion and tomato in olive oil.
Add rice, black beans and paprika.
Fill pepper halves with the mixture.

name: Vegan Apple Cinnamon Overnight Oats
steps: Add oats and chia seeds to a jar.

name: Vegan Grilled Vegetable Wrap
steps: Grill until tender and lightly browned.

name: 15-Minute Garlic Butter Pasta
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water.
Melt butter with olive oil in a pan.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add drained spaghetti and a little pasta water.
Add Parmesan, parsley and black pepper.

name: Quick Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Place filling and cheese on half of each tortilla.
Cook in a pan until golden and cheese melts.

name: Easy Tomato and Mozzarella Toast
steps: Arrange tomato and mozzarella on bread.
Season with black pepper and serve.

name: 10-Minute Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Dice carrot and cook with peas.
Add soy sauce and scrambled eggs.

name: Quick Tuna Avocado Wrap
steps: Mix tuna with yogurt and black pepper.

name: Easy Creamy Mushroom Toast
steps: Spoon mushrooms over toast and garnish with parsley.

name: Quick Greek Cucumber Salad
steps: Wash and chop cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix olive oil with lemon juice.

name: 15-Minute Chicken Stir Fry
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.

name: Easy Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
steps: Add banana, milk, peanut butter and oats to a blender.
Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Easy Cheesy Baked Potatoes
steps: Wash and pierce potatoes with a fork.
Microwave for 8 to 10 minutes until tender.
Return to microwave for 1 minute until cheese melts.

name: Quick Lemon Garlic Shrimp
steps: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan.
Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque.
Add lemon juice, salt and pepper.

name: Easy Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Mix olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Combine dressing with pasta and vegetables.

name: 15-Minute Vegetable Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan.
Fold omelette and garnish with parsley.

name: Quick Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Stir until sauce thickens and coats chicken.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Fast Chickpea Spinach Wrap
steps: Mash chickpeas lightly with lemon juice and paprika.

name: Quick Tomato Basil Gnocchi
steps: Cook gnocchi according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Easy Tuna and Corn Salad
steps: Place all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix lemon juice and olive oil.

name: 15-Minute Chocolate Banana Mug Cake
steps: Mash banana in a microwave-safe mug.
Add flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
Pour in milk and mix until smooth.
Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes until cooked.
Allow to cool slightly before serving.
